_readme: English source catalog. Edit the text here; run `npm run translate` to refresh the other nine languages. Every entry needs a short note for translators. {name} style placeholders must be kept exactly. Plural keys end in .one/.other (and .zero where used).

translate.working.note: Small status shown at the bottom of the screen while the rest of the page is being translated. Keep it very short.

translate.unavailable.text: Translation is temporarily unavailable. The page stays in English.
translate.unavailable.note: Shown when the automatic translation service cannot be reached.

translate.dismiss.note: Screen-reader name of the button that closes the translation notice.

footer.nav.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the footer navigation.

footer.name.note: Name of the kingdom in the footer. Keep Kingdom 710 as is.

footer.tag.note: Short slogan under the kingdom name. KvK stays KvK.

footer.group.members.note: Footer column heading for pages that need a member sign-in.

footer.link.home.note: Footer link to the home page.

footer.link.apply.note: Footer link to the application page for people who want to join.

footer.link.help.note: Footer link to the help page.

footer.link.about.note: Footer link to the About page.

footer.link.timeline.note: Footer link to the game release timeline.

footer.link.gallery.note: Footer link to the picture gallery.

footer.link.glossary.note: Footer link to the glossary of game words.

footer.link.dashboard.note: Footer link to the member dashboard.

footer.link.power.note: Footer link to the power profile form.

footer.link.forms.note: Footer link to the member forms.

footer.link.tools.note: Footer link to the calculators and tools.

footer.link.events.note: Footer link to the events page.

footer.donate.note: Text of the donation link. Keep K710 Hub.

footer.donate.aria.text: Support K710 Hub (opens Ko-fi donation page in a new tab)
footer.donate.aria.note: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the donation link.

form.closed.title.note: Heading of the notice shown instead of a closed form.

form.closed.default.text: An admin has closed this form for now. Check back later.
form.closed.default.note: Default explanation under the closed-form heading.

form.errors.one.note: Heading of the error summary above a form when exactly one field has a problem.

form.errors.other.note: Heading of the error summary when several fields have problems. {count} is a number.

lang.button.label.note: Short label for the language picker button and dialog.

lang.button.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the language button. {language} is the current language's own name, for example Español.

lang.picker.title.note: Heading of the language picker dialog.

lang.picker.close.note: Button that closes the language picker without changing anything.

lang.picker.selected.note: Screen-reader text for the check mark on the language that is in use.

lang.picker.hint.text: Tap a language to switch. The whole page changes at once.
lang.picker.hint.note: One short line under the picker heading.

chrome.skip.note: Keyboard link at the very top of every page that jumps past the menu.

chrome.menu.note: Button that opens the navigation menu on a phone.

chrome.menu.open.note: Screen-reader name of the menu button when the menu is closed.

chrome.menu.close.note: Screen-reader name of the menu button when the menu is open.

chrome.nav.home.note: Navigation link to the home page.

chrome.nav.about.note: Navigation menu title for the About section.

chrome.nav.aboutKingdom.note: Navigation link. Kingdom 710 is the name of the game kingdom; keep 710.

chrome.nav.timeline.note: Navigation link to the page that lists when game features were released.

chrome.nav.gallery.note: Navigation link to the photo and screenshot gallery.

chrome.nav.glossary.note: Navigation link to the page that explains game words.

chrome.nav.guides.note: Navigation link to the how-to guides.

chrome.nav.help.note: Navigation link to the help page.

chrome.nav.members.note: Navigation menu title for pages only for kingdom members.

chrome.nav.dashboard.note: Navigation link to the member's home page with their forms.

chrome.nav.forms.note: Navigation link to the list of forms members fill in.

chrome.nav.tools.note: Navigation link to the calculators and planning tools.

chrome.nav.events.note: Navigation link to the event schedules.

chrome.nav.apply.note: Button for players who want to join the kingdom.

chrome.nav.powerProfile.note: Navigation link. Power Profile is a form name; keep it in English.

chrome.nav.myForms.note: Small heading in the Members menu above the list of the member's forms.

chrome.nav.donate.note: Link to the page where people can support the website with a donation.

chrome.nav.mobileLabel.note: Screen-reader name of the phone navigation.

shared.logout.note: Button that ends the member's session.

shared.loggingOut.note: Shown on the log out button while it is working.

shared.open.note: Generic button that opens a page.

shared.close.note: Generic button that closes a panel.

shared.back.note: Generic button that goes back one step.

shared.save.note: Generic button that saves what the member typed.

shared.cancel.note: Generic button that stops without saving.

shared.dash.note: Shown instead of a number when the value is not known. Keep as is.

formStatus.todo.note: Status chip: the member has not filled in this form yet. Shown with an icon and in red.

formStatus.done.note: Status chip: the member has filled in this form. Shown with a check mark and in green.

formStatus.carry.note: Status chip: answers from the last event are filled in; the member should check them and save.

formStatus.closed.note: Status chip: the form is not accepting answers.

formStatus.soon.note: Status chip: the form is not open yet.

formButton.fill.note: Big button that opens a form the member has not done. Short imperative.

formButton.change.note: Quieter button that opens a form the member already saved, so they can edit it.

formButton.check.note: Button that opens a form whose answers were carried over from last time.

formButton.closed.note: Disabled button text for a form that cannot be opened.

formButton.aria.note: Screen-reader name of a form button. {action} is the button text, {form} the form title.

formButton.numberAria.note: Screen-reader name of the number badge on a form card.

form.date.before.note: Deadline line on a form card. {date} is a date and time in the member's own time zone, already formatted.

form.date.opens.note: Line on a form card that is not open yet. {date} is already formatted.

form.date.none.note: Shown on a form card when leadership has not given a closing time.

form.saved.note: Shown on a form card the member already saved. {date} is a short date such as 8 Oct.

form.prep.title.note: Form name. KvK = Kingdom vs Kingdom battle; keep KvK. Keep the name in English or translate only 'Prep' and 'Appointments' if natural.

form.prep.help.text: Chief Minister buffs · before prep days
form.prep.help.note: One line under the form name. Chief Minister is a game role name; keep it in English. 'Prep days' are the preparation days before a KvK.

form.noble.title.note: Form name. Noble Advisor is a game role; keep in English.

form.noble.help.note: One line under the form name. Members pick a time slot when their troops train with the Noble Advisor.

form.dragon.title.note: Form and event name; keep in English.

form.dragon.help.text: Your troops and heroes for the event
form.dragon.help.note: One line under the form name. 'Heroes' are the in-game hero characters.

form.joiner.title.note: Form name. KvK = Kingdom vs Kingdom battle; keep KvK.

form.joiner.help.text: When you can play · troops and heroes
form.joiner.help.note: One line under the form name. Members say which battle hours they can be online.

dash.pageTitle.note: Browser tab and screen-reader name of the member home page.

dash.greeting.note: Big greeting at the top of the member page. {name} is the player's in-game name.

dash.left.one.text: You have {count} form left to do.
dash.left.one.note: Sentence under the greeting. {count} is shown in a bright colour. Singular: exactly one form left.

dash.left.other.text: You have {count} forms left to do.
dash.left.other.note: Plural of the sentence above, for any number other than one.

dash.allDone.note: Calm message when every open form is done.

dash.allDoneHint.text: You can still change your answers any time while a form is open.

dash.nothingOpen.text: Nothing to fill in right now. Check back when leadership opens a form.
dash.nothingOpen.note: Shown when no form is open. 'Leadership' means the kingdom's officers.

dash.myForms.note: Heading of the forms card on the member dashboard.

dash.todoCount.note: Small count after the My forms heading, for example 2 to do. {count} is a number.

dash.formsHeading.note: Heading above the numbered list of form cards.

dash.alsoOpen.note: Heading above short rows for extra forms (event votes) that are open.

dash.loading.note: Shown while the list of forms loads.

dash.loadError.text: We could not load your forms just now. Try again in a moment.
dash.loadError.note: Error shown when the form list cannot be loaded.

dash.loadErrorLink.note: Link next to the load error that goes to the full forms list.

dash.result.label.note: Small label on a row that shows a decision made by leadership (for example an appointment time), not a form to fill in.

dash.result.new.note: Highlight on a result row when leadership has just published the member's appointment.

dash.result.see.note: Button on a result row when the member's appointment time is ready.

dash.power.title.note: Row title. Power Profile is a form name; keep it in English. Optional = not required.

dash.power.help.note: Short hint on the Power Profile row. Charms and Governor Gear are game items; the scanner reads game screenshots.

dash.power.todo.note: Small status on the Power Profile row when the member has not filled it in.

dash.more.title.note: Title of the collapsed section at the bottom of the member page.

dash.more.hint.note: Short hint on the collapsed More section listing what is inside.

dash.more.allForms.note: Link to the page that lists every form.

dash.more.events.note: Link to the event calendar and schedules.

dash.more.tools.note: Link to calculators that help plan upgrades.

dash.more.giftCodes.note: Heading for the section with in-game gift codes.

dash.more.deadlines.note: Heading for the list of upcoming events and form deadlines.

dash.more.noDeadlines.text: No dated events or deadlines are scheduled yet.
dash.more.noDeadlines.note: Shown when the deadline list is empty.

dash.more.dueSoon.note: Small tag on a deadline that is less than two days away.

dash.more.estimated.note: Warning on a deadline whose date is a guess.

dash.account.title.note: Heading for the player's account details.

dash.account.connected.note: Shows the player is signed in with their game account.

dash.account.kingdom.note: {id} is the kingdom number, for example 710.

dash.account.noAlliance.note: Shown when the player has no alliance.

dash.account.power.note: Label for the player's total strength number in the game.

dash.account.mysticTrial.note: Game feature name; keep in English. Label for the player's best Mystic Trial result.

dash.account.session.text: Signed in with Kingshot. Your session stays active for 30 days unless you log out.
dash.account.session.note: Kingshot is the name of the game; keep it. Explains how long the login lasts.

dash.account.noAdmin.text: Your member account does not have administrator access.
dash.account.noAdmin.note: Shown when a member tried to open the admin area without permission.

dash.footer.text: Times are shown in your own time zone.
dash.footer.note: Footer note on the member page.

dash.wordmarkAria.note: Screen-reader name of the logo link at the top left. Keep K710.

dash.mainAria.note: Screen-reader name of the main page area.

dash.sideAria.note: Screen-reader name of the side column on desktop.

dash.moreNavAria.note: Screen-reader name of the list of links inside the More section.

easy.label.note: Button that switches to larger text and bigger buttons.

easy.aria.text: Easy view: larger text and buttons
easy.aria.note: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the Easy view button.

alliances.discord.link.note: Small button next to a leader's name that opens their Discord profile. Keep Discord as is.

alliances.discord.aria.note: Screen-reader name of the Discord button. {name} is a person's name and must stay exactly as written. Keep Discord as is.

alliances.bearHunts.note: Small label above an alliance's daily Bear Hunt times. Bear Hunt is a game event and keeps its English name.

alliances.view.note: Link at the bottom of an alliance box. {tag} is the alliance short name such as RED and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.status.open.note: Status label of an alliance that is accepting new members.

alliances.status.selective.note: Status label of an alliance that only accepts some applicants.

alliances.status.closed.note: Status label of an alliance that is not accepting new members.

alliances.leadership.none.text: Leadership will be listed here soon.
alliances.leadership.none.note: Calm line shown in the Leadership panel when no leaders have been added yet.

alliances.leadership.contact.note: Small role label above a leadership contact given only as free text.

alliances.strip.status.note: Small caps label of the recruiting status cell at the top of an alliance page.

alliances.strip.members.note: Small caps label above the number of members of an alliance.

alliances.strip.language.note: Small caps label above the main language of an alliance.

alliances.strip.timezone.note: Small caps label above the timezone focus of an alliance.

alliances.eyebrow.note: Small line above the alliance name in the page banner. Kingdom 710 stays as is. {tag} is the alliance short name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.back.note: Link back to the list of all alliances. Keep the arrow.

alliances.panel.leadership.note: Heading of the panel that lists the alliance leaders (R5, R4, Transfer Manager).

alliances.panel.bear.note: Heading of the panel with the alliance's daily Bear Hunt times. Bear Hunt keeps its English name.

alliances.panel.join.note: Heading of the panel that invites visitors to apply to the alliance.

alliances.bear.calendar.text: Add {tag} Bear Hunts to my calendar
alliances.bear.calendar.note: Link that downloads a calendar file with the alliance's Bear Hunt times. {tag} is the alliance short name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.bear.all.text: See all alliance Bear Hunt times →
alliances.bear.all.note: Link to the page listing every alliance. Keep the arrow.

alliances.join.line.text: Ready to move? Send a transfer application and our officers will help you join {name}.
alliances.join.line.note: Short invitation in the Join panel. {name} is the alliance name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.join.cta.note: Button that opens the transfer application. {name} is the alliance name and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.discord.short.note: Short label of the small outlined button next to a leader's name on the alliance pages. Discord is a product name and stays as is. The full sentence for screen readers is alliances.discord.aria.

alliances.panel.bearHunt.note: Heading of the panel with the alliance's daily Bear Hunt times on the alliance page. Bear Hunt is a game event and keeps its English name.

alliances.bear.hunt.note: Row label in the Bear Hunt list: Hunt 1, Hunt 2 and so on, one per daily Bear Hunt of an alliance. {n} is the number of the hunt and must stay exactly as written. Hunt here means one Bear Hunt event.

alliances.rail.others.note: Heading of the small side card that lists every alliance as a short link (710, RED, SKY and so on) so a visitor can jump to another alliance page. Alliance short names are not translated.

alliances.rail.onPage.note: Heading of the small side card with links that jump to sections of the alliance page.

alliances.rail.overview.note: Link text that jumps to the top of the alliance page (banner and status). Shown in the On this page card.

alliances.rail.nextHunt.note: Small caps label of the side card with the countdown to the alliance's next Bear Hunt. Bear Hunt is a game event and keeps its English name.

alliances.rail.nextLine.note: Line under the countdown naming which Bear Hunt is next and its UTC time. {n} is the hunt number and {utc} a clock time such as 13:00; both must stay exactly as written. Keep UTC.

alliances.rail.local.note: Your local clock time of the next Bear Hunt, shown after the UTC time. {time} is a clock time such as 09:00 PM and must stay exactly as written.

alliances.rail.kvk.note: Small caps label of the side card with the kingdom's battle record. KvK keeps its name.

alliances.rail.kvkWins.note: Hidden text read by screen readers after the record such as 11-2, meaning wins to losses.

alliances.rail.updated.note: Small note under the KvK record: the figure refreshes by itself from the kingdom ranking source.

alliances.rail.lastKnown.note: Small note under the KvK record when the live figure could not be refreshed and the last saved figure is shown.

alliances.rail.apply.note: Gold button in the side column that opens the transfer application.

tour.ui.next.note: Button in the form walkthrough that goes to the next tip. One short word.

tour.ui.back.note: Button in the form walkthrough that goes to the previous tip. One short word.

tour.ui.skip.note: Button that closes the form walkthrough early. Keep it short; the layout is tight on phones.

tour.ui.done.note: Button on the last tip of the form walkthrough that finishes it. One short word.

tour.ui.replay.note: Button near a form title that starts the step-by-step walkthrough again.

tour.ui.take.note: Button near a form title that starts the step-by-step walkthrough for the first time.

tour.ui.stepOf.note: Progress label in the walkthrough, for example Step 2 of 6. Keep {current} and {total} exactly.

tour.ui.live.note: Read aloud by screen readers when the walkthrough moves to a new tip. Keep {current}, {total} and {title} exactly.

tour.ui.more.text: More tips appear as you move to the next part of the form.
tour.ui.more.note: Small line in the walkthrough on forms that have several screens. Tells people the tips continue on the next screen.

tour.ui.esc.text: Press Esc to skip at any time.
tour.ui.esc.note: Small keyboard hint in the walkthrough. Esc is the Escape key; keep the key name.

tour.prep.1.title.note: Heading of tip 1 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.1.body.text: This one form is how you ask for your Chief Minister and Noble Advisor buffs and tell leadership when you can be online on the KvK prep days. Leadership gives each person at most one time per day.
tour.prep.1.body.note: Explanation in tip 1 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.prep.2.title.note: Heading of tip 2 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.2.body.text: Your in-game name is filled in from your account. Fix it if it is wrong. Your Member ID comes from your login and cannot be changed.
tour.prep.2.body.note: Explanation in tip 2 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.prep.3.title.text: One question for each prep day
tour.prep.3.title.note: Heading of tip 3 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.3.body.text: Day 1 is Construction and Day 2 is Research (Chief Minister buff). Day 4 is Troop Training (Noble Advisor buff). Day 5 is a second chance if leadership could not fit you in on Day 1 or Day 2. Answer Yes or No for each day.
tour.prep.3.body.note: Explanation in tip 3 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.prep.4.title.text: Pick every half hour you can be online
tour.prep.4.title.note: Heading of tip 4 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.4.body.text: After you answer Yes, a few follow-up questions appear, then a grid of half hours. Tap every half hour you can be online. Times are UTC, and your local time is shown under each one.
tour.prep.4.body.note: Explanation in tip 4 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.prep.5.title.note: Heading of tip 5 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.5.body.text: This list shows your answer for each day and how many times you picked. Look it over and fix anything before you save.
tour.prep.5.body.note: Explanation in tip 5 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.prep.6.title.note: Heading of tip 6 in the prep form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.prep.6.body.text: Press Save. You can come back and save again to change your answers. Leadership publishes the schedule on the My appointment page.
tour.prep.6.body.note: Explanation in tip 6 of the prep form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.1.title.note: Heading of tip 1 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.1.body.text: Tell leadership when you can play and what you are bringing for this KvK. Your answers are filled in from last time, so just check them and press Save.
tour.avail.1.body.note: Explanation in tip 1 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.2.title.note: Heading of tip 2 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.2.body.text: Select the alliance you are in right now.
tour.avail.2.body.note: Explanation in tip 2 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.3.title.note: Heading of tip 3 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.3.body.text: Choose the window that rally planners should count on for you.
tour.avail.3.body.note: Explanation in tip 3 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.4.title.note: Heading of tip 4 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.4.body.text: Choose the best tier and TG for Infantry, Cavalry and Archer, as they stand for this KvK. All three are required. They are remembered on your profile and filled in for you next time.
tour.avail.4.body.note: Explanation in tip 4 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.5.title.note: Heading of tip 5 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.5.body.text: Select the heroes you have available for this KvK.
tour.avail.5.body.note: Explanation in tip 5 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.avail.6.title.note: Heading of tip 6 in the avail form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.avail.6.body.text: Press Save KvK Availability. A message confirms it is saved, and you can open this form again later to change it.
tour.avail.6.body.note: Explanation in tip 6 of the avail form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.dragon.1.title.note: Heading of tip 1 in the dragon form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.dragon.1.body.text: This form tells leadership what you are bringing to the Flamedragon Tyrant battle: troops, heroes, power and when you can play, so rally planners can use it.
tour.dragon.1.body.note: Explanation in tip 1 of the dragon form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.dragon.2.title.note: Heading of tip 2 in the dragon form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.dragon.2.body.text: Select the alliance you are in right now. The in-game name above it is filled in from your account, so fix it if it is wrong.
tour.dragon.2.body.note: Explanation in tip 2 of the dragon form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.dragon.3.title.note: Heading of tip 3 in the dragon form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.dragon.3.body.text: Choose the best tier and TG for Infantry, Cavalry and Archer, as they stand for this battle. All three are required, and they are remembered on your profile for next time.
tour.dragon.3.body.note: Explanation in tip 3 of the dragon form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.dragon.4.title.note: Heading of tip 4 in the dragon form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.dragon.4.body.text: Select the heroes you have available for this battle.
tour.dragon.4.body.note: Explanation in tip 4 of the dragon form walkthrough, shown in a small popup, so it may grow about 40 percent in your language. Keep game words in English: Chief Minister, Noble Advisor, KvK, TG, T11, Governor Gear, Charms, Power Profile, Mystic Trial, Gift Codes, hero and alliance names.

tour.dragon.5.title.note: Heading of tip 5 in the dragon form walkthrough. Short. Keep game words in English: KvK, TG, T11, Noble Advisor, Power Profile.

tour.dragon.5.body.text: Set your Charm levels and Governor Gear, then type your power numbers and your Mystic Trial total score.

interest.verify.title.note: Heading of the optional verification panel at the top of the transfer application. Keep the word Kingshot. Short.

interest.verify.lede.text: We read your name, kingdom, alliance and power straight from the game, so officers can trust them. It takes about a minute.
interest.verify.lede.note: Intro under the verification heading. Plain, friendly words for players who may not be tech-savvy.

interest.verify.loading.note: Shown for a moment while the page checks whether the person already verified.

interest.verify.playerId.label.note: Label of the Player ID box inside the verification panel.

interest.verify.playerId.hint.text: Open Kingshot and tap your picture in the top-left corner. Your Player ID is the number shown there.
interest.verify.playerId.hint.note: Help line under the Player ID box. Keep the word Kingshot.

interest.verify.sendHint.text: Open Kingshot on your phone first. Then press the button and we send a short code to the game.
interest.verify.sendHint.note: Instruction above the send-code button. The code arrives inside the game as a message.

interest.verify.send.text: Open Kingshot, then send my code
interest.verify.send.note: Button text. The person opens the game first, then presses it. Keep the word Kingshot.

interest.verify.sending.note: Button text while the code is being requested.

interest.verify.invalidId.text: That Player ID does not look right. Use only numbers, at least 4 digits.
interest.verify.invalidId.note: Error under the Player ID box when it is empty or not a number.

interest.verify.code.title.note: Heading of the second verification step where the person types the code from the game.

interest.verify.code.hint.text: Look in Kingshot for a message with a short code. Type it here. The code stops working after a few minutes.
interest.verify.code.hint.note: Help line above the code box. Keep the word Kingshot.

interest.verify.code.placeholder.note: Placeholder inside the code box. Very short.

interest.verify.code.submit.note: Button text that checks the typed code.

interest.verify.code.checking.note: Button text while the code is being checked.

interest.verify.code.resend.note: Text button under the code box that asks the game for another code.

interest.verify.code.resent.text: A new code was sent. Look in Kingshot.
interest.verify.code.resent.note: Confirmation after a new code was requested. Keep the word Kingshot.

interest.verify.codeFormat.text: Enter the code shown in the game (4 to 12 letters or numbers).
interest.verify.codeFormat.note: Error when the typed code has the wrong shape.

interest.verify.otherId.note: Text button that goes back to the Player ID step.

interest.verify.skip.text: Can't log in? Apply without verifying
interest.verify.skip.note: Visible link under the verification panel. The person then types everything themselves.

interest.verify.skipped.title.note: Heading shown after the person chose to apply without verifying.

interest.verify.skipped.body.text: You will type everything yourself. Officers will see this application marked as unverified.
interest.verify.skipped.body.note: Explains what happens when the person skips verification.

interest.verify.skipped.back.note: Text button that brings the verification panel back.

interest.verify.done.body.text: {name}, Player ID {playerId}. The locked answers below were filled in from your Kingshot account.
interest.verify.done.body.note: Shown after verification. {name} is the in-game name, {playerId} the Player ID. Keep both placeholders exactly.

interest.verify.done.announce.text: Verified. Your name, Player ID, kingdom, alliance and power are filled in from the game.

interest.verify.different.note: Text button that signs the verification out so another Player ID can be used.

interest.verify.lock.note: Small label with a lock icon next to a form answer that came from the game and cannot be edited.

interest.verify.selfReported.hint.text: We could not read this from the game, so please type it. It will be marked as self-reported.
interest.verify.selfReported.hint.note: Shown under a power or Mystic Trial box when the game did not give a number. Keep Mystic Trial in English.

interest.verify.selfReported.tag.note: Small tag in the review step next to a number the person typed themselves.

interest.verify.expired.text: Your verification ran out (it lasts 3 hours). You can verify again, or carry on and we will save your application as unverified.
interest.verify.expired.note: Gentle message when the verification expired while the form was open.

interest.verify.review.verified.text: This account was verified by the game.
interest.verify.review.verified.note: Line in the review step when the application is verified.

interest.verify.review.unverified.text: This account is not verified. Officers will see the application marked as unverified.
interest.verify.review.unverified.note: Line in the review step when the application is not verified.
